# docs.skyhitz.io: documentation for HITZ Protocol, oracle-free,
# protocol-owned liquidity on Stellar.
#
# Everything here is open to every crawler: search engines, AI search,
# assistants fetching a page for someone, and crawlers collecting training
# data. An index written for language models is at /llms.txt, every page is
# also plain markdown (/whitepaper.md), and all of them in one file at
# /llms-full.txt.
#
# This site's content may be used for search, as input to AI answers, and to
# train AI models (in the terms of https://contentsignals.org: search=yes,
# ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes). It is stated here in words, not as a
# Content-Signal line, because robots.txt validators reject directives they
# don't know.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
